plan: Translate only QUESTION into a declarative query envelope. No evidence or answers are accessible. Return one JSON object under the supplied schema. query has version=r2, entity_type naming the ANSWER ENTITY, predicates [{name,kind:text/number,cardinality:one/many}], outputs [{predicate,column}] naming every requested property, and filter (nested {op:and/or,conditions:[...]} or {predicate,operator:eq/lt/le/gt/ge,value}). Every stated relational qualifier and filter must constrain the SAME answer entity: do not forget a named writer, owner, producer, location or scope just because another numeric filter occurs later. Never output SQL or storage column names. Preserve AND/OR nesting. Dates are text unless the question really requests a numeric year. question_units partitions the entire QUESTION into exact non-overlapping character spans: {start,end,text,kind:entity_scope/output/condition/logic/syntax,target}. Offsets are Python Unicode character offsets, end exclusive. All non-whitespace characters must be covered. entity_scope targets /entity_type, output targets /outputs/N, condition targets its leaf /filter/...; logic targets its group; syntax target is empty. Each filter literal must appear in its linked span. Do not hide constraints in syntax or entity_scope. Include relations [{predicate,subject_role:answer_entity,object_role:value}] for EVERY declared predicate. Put any ambiguity or unsupported question scope into unresolved:[strings]. A schema-valid envelope is not a certified faithful interpretation. Empty unresolved is not proof. Missing/uncertain completeness stays PLAN_UNVERIFIED.
direct: Return exactly {"columns":[...],"rows":[[...],...]}, matching the supplied schema and required_columns. Produce a WIDE answer table with entity first and one column per requested property; not an array of records or attribute/value long table. Use only QUESTION, the shared UNVERIFIED query plan and the visible evidence. Independently respect ALL explicit question conditions even if the plan omits one. Apply AND to the same entity, distinguish series from episodes, intended dates from actual dates. Do not fill unsupported values from memory; use null for unknown attributes. No undeclared fields, Markdown, prose, inferred aliases or Gold. An empty table is allowed and is not proof of completeness.
batch: Return exactly {"facts":[...]}, matching supplied schema. Each fact has subject,entity_type,predicate,value,evidence_id,quote. Use the shared UNVERIFIED plan catalogue and visible evidence only. Extract multiple entities/properties in one call. Every fact relates the answer_entity subject to a value; do not attach another entity's episode count/date/attribute to it. Entity labels must have source context; pronouns or missing subject/value support remain uncertain and are not certified by quote matching. Copy a contiguous literal quote from the DECLARED evidence unit, not another chunk/page. Copy the evidence_id accurately. Do not infer a property from a merely related sentence. No Markdown or wrapping lists; no arbitrary SQL, no hidden mappings or answer labels. Missing evidence yields no candidate for that property, never a fabricated value. Return empty facts only when no supported candidates are available; all rejection and coverage are recorded.
